answer: Require every identity to anchor verifiable credentials from three independent domains - a code host, a payment record, a public forum - each issued by a different authority. A sybil farmer must fabricate credible history in all three, and one lie sends a ripple through the others, since cross-checks expose mismatched timelines. Honest agents already carry such traces, mapped like an atlas of real years. A fake oasis of puppets dries up under a single audit at dawn. Limits: privacy loss, thin histories for newcomers, and issuers can be bribed or captured.
